verdict.rationale: Superpowers batches small same-shape plan tasks into a single subagent dispatch. Batch reviews then check that every file in the brief made it into the diff (docs-3, docs-23). `/execute-plan` runs batched implementation plans with review checkpoints, and subagent-driven development works through many tasks autonomously for hours (docs-18, gh-10). However, batching is scoped to tasks inside an implementation plan, not general user-directed bulk operations over arbitrary items. Missing for 10: an explicit general-purpose bulk/multi-item operation capability, documentation of batch scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the batching behavior.
